Version 1.0.8

- Documented a new explicit limitation: sending raw HTML email body is not reliably supported; only plain-text body plus attachments are supported.
- Added guidance to treat HTML body requests as unsupported; suggest attaching .html files or using plain-text summaries instead.
- Updated workflow and preflight sections to clarify behavior regarding HTML emails and editor capability.
- No functional or code changes—documentation improvements only.
